en.name: Clean Energy Sprint
en.description: A competition for founders accelerating decarbonization across LATAM cities through generation, storage, grid, and efficiency solutions.
en.detailSubtitle: For teams building practical clean-energy systems with clear deployment potential in industrial, city, and infrastructure environments.
en.metaTitle: Clean Energy Sprint | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Learn about the Clean Energy Sprint competition for climate and energy founders.
en.overviewHtml: Clean Energy Sprint backs founders who can combine scalable technology with realistic deployment models across the LATAM-China energy corridor.
en.eligibilityHtml:
• Startups in clean generation, storage, grid software, energy efficiency, or industrial decarbonization.
  • Teams with pilots, technical readiness, or clear commercial traction.
  • Founders ready to articulate deployment partners and market timing.
en.supportHtml:
• Access to sector-focused visibility and partner conversations.
  • Support refining market-entry messaging for investors and operators.
  • Hands-on review before final competition submission.
en.processHtml:
1. Submit through the unified competition application page.
  2. Share your technology summary, market context, and supporting files.
  3. Coordinate follow-up review with the LATAM China Tech team.

br.name: Clean Energy Sprint
br.description: Competicao para founders que aceleram a descarbonizacao em cidades LATAM com solucoes de geracao, armazenamento, rede e eficiencia.
br.detailSubtitle: Para equipes que constroem sistemas de energia limpa com potencial real de implantacao em cidades, industria e infraestrutura.
br.metaTitle: Clean Energy Sprint | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Conheca o Clean Energy Sprint, competicao para founders de clima e energia.
br.overviewHtml: O Clean Energy Sprint apoia startups que combinam tecnologia escalavel com modelos realistas de implantacao no corredor energetico LATAM-China.
br.eligibilityHtml:
• Startups em geracao limpa, storage, software de rede, eficiencia energetica ou descarbonizacao industrial.
  • Times com pilotos, maturidade tecnica ou tracao comercial inicial.
  • Founders prontos para explicar parceiros de implantacao e timing de mercado.
br.supportHtml:
• Visibilidade setorial e conversas com parceiros.
  • Apoio para refinar narrativa de entrada em mercado.
  • Revisao pratica antes da submissao final.
br.processHtml:
1. Envie pela pagina unificada de aplicacao.
  2. Compartilhe resumo da tecnologia, contexto de mercado e arquivos de apoio.
  3. Coordene o follow-up com a equipe LATAM China Tech.

cn.name: Clean Energy Sprint
cn.description: 面向能源生成、储能、电网和效率优化团队的城市脱碳竞赛。
cn.detailSubtitle: 适合构建清洁能源系统并具备真实部署潜力的团队，应用场景包括城市、工业和基础设施。
cn.metaTitle: Clean Energy Sprint | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 了解 Clean Energy Sprint，这是一项面向气候与能源创业者的竞赛。
cn.overviewHtml: Clean Energy Sprint 支持能够把可扩展技术与现实部署模型结合起来的团队，推动中拉能源合作落地。
cn.eligibilityHtml:
• 从事清洁发电、储能、电网软件、能效或工业脱碳的创业公司。
  • 具备试点、技术成熟度或初步商业牵引力的团队。
  • 能够清晰说明部署伙伴和市场时机的创始人。
cn.supportHtml:
• 面向行业伙伴的曝光与交流机会。
  • 市场进入叙事与定位优化支持。
  • 正式提交前的材料审核建议。
cn.processHtml:
1. 通过统一竞赛申请页面提交。
  2. 上传技术摘要、市场背景和支持文件。
  3. 与 LATAM China Tech 团队协调后续审核。
